body.title: New read tools, part 1
body.summary: Add git_rev_parse, git_rev_list, git_ls_files, git_ls_tree, git_cat_file (batch, base64, isolation via runShellBytes) and git_for_each_ref (merged, noMerged, pointsAt, contains) each with typebox input and output schema, no free-form argument list, the same spawn, timeout and failure path, and parsers from t3.
acceptanceChecks: Each tool returns the documented shape against a real temporary repository
git_cat_file batch returns binary content intact as base64 and honours the isolation
git_for_each_ref filters by merged, noMerged, pointsAt and contains correctly
Unsafe arguments are rejected and each tool has approval none

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: every new read tool returns data that fits its outputSchema

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_cat_file returns a binary blob unchanged in base64, batches several revs through stdin, ignores a replacement ref when isolated, rejects an object over maxBytes and stops on cancellation
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_for_each_ref contains, merged, pointsAt and noMerged select the right refs
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_cat_file reports git diagnostics exceed byte limit when stderr passes its limit
